2. Bown, Chad P., and Dan Wang. 2024. "[Semiconductors and Modern Industrial Policy](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257/jep.38.4.81)." *Journal of Economic Perspectives* 38(4): 81–110.
3. {{< fa headphones >}} [*Trade Talks* ep. 182: "Is China's Industrial Policy Working?"](https://tradetalkspodcast.com/podcast/182-is-chinas-industrial-policy-working/)

::: {.callout-tip}
## In class today
- When does the state intervene in trade for its own goals, not a lobby's?
- The infant-industry case: when a tariff or subsidy can actually raise welfare
- Strategic-trade theory: rents, first-mover advantage, and rent-shifting
- From economic competitiveness to national and economic security as the rationale
- The political-economy objections: picking winners, rent-seeking, and the new evidence
- **Student-led article presentation** (Bown & Wang 2024)
- Writing prompt and discussion
:::
